int fastPower(int base, int exp) {
    int result=1;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (long long)result * base % mod;
        base = (long long)base * base % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int combination(int i, int j) {
    return (long long)comb[i] * invComb[j] % mod * invComb[i - j] % mod;
}

    int i, j, k;
    int answer=0;
    int mask, remaining, temp, current, c1, c2;

        printf("%d\n", fastPower(K, n));
        return 0;
    }

    comb[0]=1;
    for (i=1; i<=n; i++) comb[i] = (long long)comb[i-1]*i % mod;

    invComb[n] = fastPower(comb[n], mod-2);
    invComb[0] = 1;
    for (i=n-1; i>=1; i--) invComb[i] = (long long)invComb[i+1]*(i+1) % mod;

    for (i=1; i<=n; i++) {

            int tmp = combination(i, current);
            for (j=0; j<=limit; j++) {

    for (j=1; j<=min(countArr[n], K); j++) {
